_comment: FINAL-LONG-WATER-02. Runtime-only local bank palette, split from terrain_playground.json because that broad file fingerprints the terrain and vegetation bakes. The accepted R6 landform, water bed, route and scatter stay byte-for-byte unchanged. This rectangle covers river-course stations 4-6 and stops west of Old Mill Crossing; the shader additionally requires real rock texture weight, so meadow tops and water remain untouched. Height-aware, noise-warped silt strata break the steep face into irregular vertical levels and horizontal intervals instead of one uniform pale engineered cut. All values are tunable after fresh capture; strength 0 restores the retained R6 look.
